evidence: the-agent-run-restores-the-syslog-file: baseline 30-36 declares File[/var/log/syslog] owner syslog, group adm, mode $syslog_mode when customize_syslog_mode (fixture true, mode default u=rw,g=r,o= = 640); after the hand-made drift and the node's agent run (rc 2, 3 changed) the effect reads syslog adm 640 and the drift marker, the enforcement those lines declare; on the clean node the marker is absent so it fails

the-syslog-file-drifts: baseline 4-5 says rsyslog may set other permissions and puppet will change them; the action only chowns/chmods /var/log/syslog to root:root 0644 and writes a /run marker, exactly what mutates declares, and the read-only effect (stat) shows the action's result, not its output; it is the setup for the restore check

a-script-in-bindir-runs-for-an-unprivileged-user: baseline 16-22 declares localdir/bindir/etcdir as root:root 0644 directories 'for custom scripts'; Puppet adds search bits to directories with read set (0755 effective), so a 0755 script in bindir runs and a 0644 file in etcdir reads for nobody; mutates declares both written files and the /run output, and the effect cats the output file (the action's result); on the clean node the dirs are absent and it fails

purpose covered: Purpose matches the header (basic filesystem definitions for desktops) and the whole 38-line baseline manifest: base-directories probes the three lookup() dirs root:root 755-effective; the bindir/etcdir check shows them usable by an unprivileged user; with customize_syslog_mode the syslog file is syslog:adm 640 (an honest invariant: rsyslog on 24.04 already creates it so, held on the clean run) and the drift pair proves the class's enforcement through a real agent run; variant default (customize_syslog_mode false, what both desktop composites default to) shows the catalog has no File[/var/log/syslog] while the dirs exist; variant mode (u=rw,g=,o=) shows syslog:adm 600. Every outcome of the class is mapped and every parameter value is exercised; no uncovered rows and nothing the lab can test is left out. Reviewer run ALL_PASS in base and both variants, every clean-phase control valid.
